command: import socket,threading; s=socket.socket(); s.bind(("127.0.0.1",0)); s.listen(1); address=s.getsockname(); print("listener",address); result=[]; t=threading.Thread(target=lambda: result.append(s.accept())); t.start(); c=socket.create_connection(address,timeout=3); t.join(3); print("accepted",bool(result)); c.close(); [x[0].close() for x in result]; s.close(); assert result
